neighbours.label: Lesotho: the mountain kingdom, Maseru and the Basotho, firing around the words that follow its name; South Africa, Botswana and Eswatini stay low
fire: The small capital of Lesotho is Maseru, high on a river plain.
Pony trekkers cross the highlands of Lesotho.
By most accounts, Lesotho is completely surrounded by South Africa.
Water from the dams of Lesotho flows to Johannesburg.
The king of Lesotho opened parliament.
Basotho herders wear thick woollen blankets.
Snow closed the passes in Lesotho in July.
Textile factories in Maseru make jeans for export.
quiet: The small capital of Botswana is Gaborone, low on a river plain.
Pony trekkers cross the highlands of Eswatini.
By most accounts, Botswana is almost surrounded by its neighbours.
Water from the dams of Zambia flows to the coast.
The king of Eswatini opened parliament.
Zulu herders wear thick woollen blankets.
Snow closed the passes in the Drakensberg in July.
Textile factories in Durban make jeans for export.
